CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:30 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

July 25, 2023

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M.

B. ROLL CALL:

Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

Absent:
None.

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

All items listed under Consent Calendar are considered by the Design Review Board to
be routine and will be enacted by one motion unless a citizen or Board Member requests
otherwise; in which case, the item will be removed for separate consideration.

ITEM 1:  Minutes: June 13, 2023
ITEM 2:  Minutes: June 27, 2023

MOTION:
  • Chairman Udani moved to approve all consent items.
  • The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  • The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 3:  3021 West Commonwealth Avenue

  •  This is an application for a one-story addition to an existing single-family
  residence.
  •  Applicant: Alison Fung, Ruby Consulting Partners, LLC

  1
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with Conditions of Approval.
  •  Discussion: Applicant was present. Chairman Udani asked the applicant if they
  wish to present the project before the Board discusses. The applicant states they
  made the changes requested by staff which were to revise the railing to match
  existing perimeter ornamental railing. Board Member Daninger stated that the
  elevation facing Commonwealth Avenue appears to be missing details in
  showing the wall transition from a flat plane to a curved wall on the southeast
  corner. Board Member Tsai continued by adding the roof along the façade in
  question should also extend to create symmetry on this elevation.
  Chairman Udani agreed that the wall should show some depth and definition to
  make evident that there is a wall transition. Vice Chairman Hernandez stated that
  the wall could be furred out to add definition.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Udani moved to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) The applicant will revise the exterior railing selection to match the
  existing ornamental iron railing located along the perimeter of the property; 2)
  Extend the roof and decorative molding on the south façade facing West
  Commonwealth Avenue to create a symmetrical and well-balanced elevation.
  This wall should also be furred-out to provide more deﬁnition and depth between
  the ﬂat wall plane and curved wall at the southeast portion of the building; 3) City
  Architect is responsible for verifying and approving the revised railing selection,
  roof extension, and wall alterations prior to submittal for Building plan check.
  •  The second was by Vice Chairman Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None

E. ADJOURNMENT:

  •  We will adjourn to the next meeting on July 25, 2023.

MOTION:

  •  Vice Chair Hernandez moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:30 P.M.
  •  The second was by Board Member Tsai
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani

ATTEST:

_____________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
